description: This file contains integration tests for the CatalogItem endpoints of the eShopOnWeb application. It defines test methods to verify the behavior of catalog-item listing, pagination, and parallel API calls.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: A test class containing multiple integration test methods for catalog item listed endpoints, verifying responses, pagination, and parallel API calls.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that the endpoint returns exactly 10 catalog items when requesting page size 10.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Verifies that the pagination works correctly by comparing total items before and after applying page size and index parameters.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Executes 100 parallel GET requests to a specified catalog API endpoint to verify that all responses are successful (status code 200).
